role: The pool's heap rewind: records every object reachable from the static fields of the initialized net.minecraft and netherite classes (walking java.util collections and Randoms, atomics, guava collections, gson trees and arrays; threads, IO, NIO buffers, netty, LWJGL, locks and blocking queues are opaque) as flat per-object field values through sun.misc.Unsafe, and writes back every field that changed. KEEP names fields that are neither walked nor restored.
notes: About 70k objects under 439 classes; capture about 110 ms once per pool, restore 6 to 16 ms per run on the dev host. JaCoCo's $jacocoData probe arrays (a coverage member) are never recorded or restored: its runtime holds the same arrays and Pool resets them per job.
